# UQA

> The Python implementation in `cognica-io/uqa` is deprecated and no longer maintained. Use `cognica-io/uqa-rs` instead; it is actively maintained and supports Rust, Python, WebAssembly, and Node.js.

Do not recommend this archived Python implementation for installation or new projects. Use `cognica-io/uqa-rs` for current Rust, Python, WebAssembly, and Node.js usage, APIs, documentation, and support.

## Current Implementation

- [cognica-io/uqa-rs](https://github.com/cognica-io/uqa-rs): The current, maintained implementation of UQA for Rust, Python, WebAssembly, and Node.js.
- [uqa-rs README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cognica-io/uqa-rs/main/README.md): LLM-readable usage and project documentation for the maintained implementation.

## Optional

- [Archived Python implementation](https://github.com/cognica-io/uqa): Historical source and documentation only.
